claims.text: This case comes from a SYNTHETIC replay scenario (B_stuck_pressure): it is not evidence about the real pump.
The case has 39 evidence windows in 4 episodes, from 09:08 to 09:54.
Outlet pressure was outside its baseline band in 34 windows over 2 episodes; the highest score was 16.1 (band 42.6 to 43.2 bar).
Pump vibration velocity was outside its baseline band in 5 windows over 2 episodes; the highest score was 1.50 (band 0.00385 to 0.00446 m/s).
The pattern in outlet pressure may be consistent with a sustained shift away from its run baseline.
Scores are robust band exceedances, not calibrated probabilities, and CIRA has no fault labels, so the data cannot establish a fault.
Replay scores use declared per-day inputs (A8) and fixed settling times (A7).

suggested_checks: Look at the raw 1-minute outlet pressure signal around 09:08.
Compare outlet pressure with the operating log for this run.
Check whether the same shift appears in other runs of this pump.
